label: preparing
what: A bridge-or-port change was being prepared/discussed at the bakery, apparently by the baker, freight, innkeeper, and neighbour; exact nature and whether it was a concrete actionable plan remain unspecified. It was not disclosed to the mayor as a confirmed proposal. Innkeeper and builder knowingly helped arrange the separate 17:30 gathering ahead of the 18:00 great-hall lighting inspection, which the mayor had approved and knew about; that is not a hidden preparation. The record does not establish a hidden plan by those gathering participants beyond the bakery reports.
